title: wesbos/3d-model-anything
why_read: A practical, well-scoped tool for turning iPhone LiDAR scans into editable browser-based 3D rooms is a nice applied demonstration of accessible 3D capture pipelines.
analysis: This project combines iPhone LiDAR scanning with photographic capture to reconstruct real indoor spaces as editable 3D models viewable with Three.js in a browser. It demonstrates a practical pipeline from consumer-grade depth sensing hardware to usable web-based 3D assets, which is relevant for AR, game development, and digital twin applications. The use of Swift for the capture app paired with a web-based viewer is a sensible architecture choice for mixed mobile-plus-web tooling. It's a nice but relatively modest utility rather than a groundbreaking technical advance.
